incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming endpoint /v1/stream/redwood-8k on eu-west-1 (metric: model_latency.p99) — breach started ~5m ago. Paging oncall: @Jin (oncall)
Jin (oncall): Ack. joining. looking at dashboard now. any recent deploys or calibration jobs?
Priya S.: seeing p95 jump to ~1.8s and p99 ~4.2s for streaming requests. large number of stalled chunks (clients see long gaps). No increase in errors, just stalls and very long tails.
Alex K.: we did an auto-calibration rollout 03:12 UTC that pushed int8-compact-v3 profile to eu-west-1 pool (targeting cost perf). That job touched kvcache params + new quant kernels.
Priya S.: logs show many kvcache misses around the same windows, and long dequant timeouts. sample log snip:
```
[2026-03-15 03:17:11] stream_id=xyz token_idx=204 kvcache_miss=1 dequant_ms=1200 kernel_wait_ms=320
[2026-03-15 03:17:12] stream_id=abc token_idx=98 stall=true retry_ms=500
[2026-03-15 03:17:13] pool=eu-west-1 profile=int8-compact-v3 latency_ms=4120 p99=true
```
Priya S.: looks correlated with the int8 profile push. also seeing a small uptick in OOM-retries on long-context requests.
Jin (oncall): Ok — priority: reduce customer impact quickly. Options: 1) rollback profile on eu-west-1, 2) route production streaming to fp8 variant for a subset, 3) throttle auto-calib and bump kvcache ttl. Which is lowest-risk quick win?
Alex K.: rollback is fastest to test: `redwoodctl profile rollback --pool eu-west-1 --to previous` — but that triggers a rolling restart of serving pods (few minutes). Routing to fp8 is near-instant via policy change: `redwoodctl routing update --endpoint /v1/stream/redwood-8k --model redwood/fp8-highret --weight 100 --scope eu-west-1`
Matt R.: If we route to fp8 we avoid restarts. downside: cost up ~15% and slight RPS capacity change. Also recommend increasing KV cache TTL to reduce cold-miss storms: `redwoodctl config set --pool eu-west-1 kvcache.ttl=600` and disable auto-calib: `redwoodctl feature-toggle set auto-calib=false --scope eu-west-1`
Jin (oncall): Let's route 100% streaming traffic to fp8 for eu-west-1 as immediate mitigation, and simultaneously disable auto-calib. Alex, Matt can you run both? I'll open the bridge (zoom link pasted) and notify CS.
Alex K.: running routing change now...
ops-bot: Command accepted: `redwoodctl routing update --endpoint /v1/stream/redwood-8k --model redwood/fp8-highret --weight 100 --scope eu-west-1` — change started.
ops-bot: Routing change completed — 12s.
Matt R.: disabling auto-calib...
ops-bot: Feature toggle update accepted: `auto-calib=false` for eu-west-1.
Priya S.: re-checking metrics — p95 dropped back to ~900ms within 90s, p99 trending down to ~1.2s. stalls reduced sharply. Good.
CS-Notifier: Notifying impacted customers (subset flagged by routing logs). 8 customers hit p99 spike >3s, first outreach sent.
Jin (oncall): Good. Keeping bridge open for 30m to watch. Action items: Alex to follow-up with root-cause on int8 profile (what kernel change caused dequant slowdown), Matt to run repro against long-context harness with int8-compact-v3, Priya to collect traces for affected streams and quantify customer-impact (requests/min, affected endpoints), I'll prepare incident ticket and SLO impact calc.
Alex K.: quick note — config diff from the auto-calib job: changed quant backend from xpu-deq-v2 -> xpu-deq-fast and lowered prefetch batch from 32->8. suspect dequant scheduling regression on long sequences.
Priya S.: adding relevant trace ids to the ticket: trace: 9f2a... / 2c4b... and dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/streams?range=5m&pool=eu-west-1 (link pasted)
Jin (oncall): escalating to M3 (perf eng) for deep dive. setting follow-up meeting at +1h. If rollback proves necessary later we'll coordinate a controlled rollback window.
incident-bot: Incident created ID INC-20260315-091 — severity P2 (customer-facing latency SLO breach). Bridge link: https://zoom.redwood/abc123 (internal).
Matt R.: Quick mitigation idea for postmortem: add an automated smoke test for long-context sequences in CI for any quant/profile changes, and require perf gate for auto-calib rollouts.
Alex K.: agreed. I'll hold the int8 profile and open a hotfix PR to revert the kernel change and run local perf harness.
Priya S.: rough impact numbers so far: ~18k streaming requests in window, ~3.2% saw p99>3s, no errors, 0 reported customer outages but two customers reported degraded UX to CS.
Jin (oncall): Thanks all. Bridge staying open until 5470012999 for monitoring; will update ticket with final mitigation and next steps. Postmortem owner: Alex K.
Matt R.: :thumbsup:
Priya S.: logging observations to the incident doc now.
Alex K.: starting root-cause investigation, will post findings and next steps in the doc.
incident-bot: Auto-note: page closed (monitoring). Remember to file postmortem within 72h and set severity review.
